text:
eve_sales: Quick heads-up — Zenith POC hit an SSO rollback during staging cutover. SAML assertions started failing after the IdP cert rotate and SCIM provisioning is getting throttled, leaving users unprovisioned. Need an immediate fallback playbook so the app doesn't block signups. Anyone on call?

sam_se: Saw it. Error is SAML 401 invalid_audience + occasional 429 from SCIM. Okta rotating certs tonight per their notice. Short-term fallback: allow invite-by-email flow + SCIM retry/backoff. Also need to consider roles (don't create admins).

lina_sec: From sec: fallback must default to least privilege (viewer). Any invite token must be one-time, signed, expire <=24h. Logs of invite actions must be auditable and PII-masked. We cannot leak user emails in plaintext logs.

nick_sre: We can ship a gated feature flag auth_fallback_v2 to handle this: detect SAML validation failures, surface an invite CTA, and enqueue a provisioning worker with exponential backoff (base 2s, max 5 retries). For Hosted customers we can use our invite endpoint; Dedicated customers need a local fallback path — we should document both.

sam_se: Concrete minimal plan for POC: 1) Detect SAML validation error and surface CTA; 2) On CTA, POST /api/v1/tenants/:tenant/invite with role=viewer and expires_in=86400; 3) Worker will attempt SCIM provisioning with exponential backoff and post status to SE slack. Need legal signoff for hosted invite route (data flow).

lina_sec: Legal/DPA note: sending invites through hosted endpoints requires DPA addendum for customer data. I'll loop Legal. For now: mask email in logs, store only hashed identifiers when possible, rotate SCIM tokens per policy. Also no admin elevation via fallback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout started: feature flag auth_fallback_v2 -> canary (10%) ci/5678 -> infra-canary-1

eve_sales: Customer question — will this fallback work for Dedicated? They are nervous about fallback touching our hosted services.

nick_sre: For Dedicated, fallback must be local. Options: a) Customer ops generate signed invites locally (we ship a generator script for them), b) We provide an on-premised fallback package that runs the invite worker. For the POC we can accept a manual admin invite path, but that needs ops runbook.

sam_se: Pricing/impact: provisioning retries and invites increase API calls. Proposal: for POC we waive the first 1k invites/retries, beyond that count against MAU/invites metering. Lina, need confirmation from finance/legal?

lina_sec: OK to waive for POC with written approval; legal wants a note in the contract and encrypted logs retained 90 days. Also require KMS-backed signing keys for invite tokens (customer-managed KMS for Dedicated, our KMS for Hosted with SIAs).

eve_sales: Next steps & owners: sam -> draft runbook + Slack snippet for SEs; nick -> implement feature flag + backoff + doc for Dedicated flow; lina -> start DPA thread with Legal; I'll coordinate with customer to reschedule cert rotate to off-peak. ETA tomorrow 12:00 PT?

sam_se: I'll drop the runbook snippet below and link to the full doc when ready. Minimal snippet: 

```
# detect SAML failure
if resp.status == 401 and 'invalid_audience' in resp.body:
  show_invite_cta()

# invite endpoint (viewer only)
POST /api/v1/tenants/zenith/invite
Body: {"email":"user@example.com","role":"viewer","expires_in":86400}

# worker pseudocode
attempt = 0
while attempt < 5:
  r = scim.provision(user)
  if r.status == 201: break
  sleep(2 ** attempt)
  attempt += 1
log.mask_and_emit({"event":"invite_provision","tenant":"zenith","user_hash":sha256(email)})
```

lina_sec: That looks fine; add a step to redact PII in any error dumps and to rotate SCIM tokens post-incident. I'll create the legal thread and request the written waiver for POC invite surcharges.

nick_sre: I'll add the auth_fallback_v2 flag to the canary pipeline and a runbook page for Dedicated: include the on-prem invite generator script and admin steps. Will also add a metric to track "fallback_invites" and an alert when >50 in 1h.

eve_sales: Thanks — once Sam posts the runbook link I'll send it to the customer and confirm the cert rotation window. If Legal signs off we can proceed with hosted fallback for the remainder of the POC.

(threads: lina_sec tagged Legal, deploy-bot posted rollout status, sam_se to follow up with runbook link)
